evidence: Committed baseline source inspection only. Source pins deliberately use immutable base blobs, not a concurrently edited draft checker.

payload_contract.native_kind: Serial default REAL32; each field emitted via TRANSFER(value,0) as eight hexadecimal digits.
payload_contract.field_index_basis: Zero-based bits/values arrays after parsing the eight numeric payload fields.
payload_contract.existing_identity: 59 levels selected (i,j)=(1,1), one serial periodic domain; START keys step0 cold/step6 restart, RK0,slot0; RESET step1 only. Exact event roster already required.

source_permissions.scope: START_PRE→START_POST immediately before physical scalar boundary processing
source_permissions.writes: Only scalar(...,p_qnn)=grid%ccn_conc when domain QNN max<1.
source_permissions.protected: No QNC/QNR write between these hooks. Scheme branch can update grid%ccn_conc, but START_PRE is after that branch.
source_permissions.gate: QNC/QNR immediate pair bits[1:3] identical in cold and restart. QNN follows existing supplied/empty branch oracle; restart has existing all-three preservation assertion.

source_permissions.scope: RESET_PRE→RESET_POST around the single full-memory QNN assignment
source_permissions.writes: QNN_CURR(...)=ccn_conc under have_udm_cf, timestep1, num_tiles>0 and original PRESENT guards.
source_permissions.protected: QNC_CURR/QNR_CURR have no assignments in the pair.
source_permissions.gate: QNC/QNR immediate pair bits[1:3] identical; QNN POST matches native REAL32 ccn_conc. Preserve existing POST→UDM_ENTRY bits[:3] gate.

minimal_checker_changes.proposal: Extend cold input join from QNCCN alone to all three names in declared QNN/QNC/QNR order. Select each [0,level-1,0,0] and compare its original float32 uint32 representation to START_PRE bits[field], not numerical ==. Require dtype float32 and expected variable shape/59-level selected slice; reject rather than silently cast an unexpected storage type.
minimal_checker_changes.claim: Authenticated selected-column cold ingestion only; no universal storage unit or population interpretation.

minimal_checker_changes.proposal: For every START_PRE/POST level pair, require bits[1:3] equality. Keep the current independent QNN supplied/empty behavior gate.
minimal_checker_changes.claim: Immediate source block leaves QNC/QNR unchanged.

minimal_checker_changes.proposal: For every exact RESET_PRE/POST identity, require bits[1:3] equality. Keep QNN reset and POST→ENTRY validation.
minimal_checker_changes.claim: Native constant reset writes only QNN.

forbidden_overreach: Do not require START_POST QNC/QNR equal RESET_PRE across actual RK transport.
Do not require UDM_ENTRY QNC/QNR equal UDM_RETURN: microphysics can change them.
Do not require cold QNC/QNR remain positive until helper except in the separately declared warm-cloud discriminator.
Do not replace the QNN max<1 initialization predicate, change ccn_conc or apply density/CF conversion.
QNR is not added to the RK two-slot roster by this proposal; its cold ingestion and local preservation do not establish a complete QNR transport trajectory.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: NORMAL_SUPPLIED_QNN
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Distinct finite REAL32 QNC/QNR input words, nonempty supplied QNN; START matches input and all three retained, reset alters only QNN.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: NORMAL_EMPTY_QNN
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Zero input QNN, distinct finite QNC/QNR; START QNN becomes configured ccn_conc, QNC/QNR unchanged; native reset still only changes QNN.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: INPUT_QNC_COHERENT_TAMPER
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Change START_PRE and START_POST QNC by the same one-bit finite amount while supplied input remains original. Immediate preservation alone passes; new ingestion gate must fail.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: INPUT_QNR_COHERENT_TAMPER
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Same coherent START-pair perturbation in QNR. Existing QNN-only cold gate misses it.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: NUMBER_ORDER_SWAP
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Swap distinct QNC/QNR words in both START records; use distinct manufactured values to avoid a vacuous equal-value case.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: START_QNC_CHANGE
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Change only POST QNC, retaining exact level/clock identity.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: START_QNR_CHANGE
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Change only POST QNR, retaining exact level/clock identity.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: RESET_QNC_QNR_CHANGE
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Perturb each field independently in RESET_POST and UDM_ENTRY consistently. Existing POST→ENTRY gate can pass; new RESET pair gate must fail.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: SIGNED_ZERO_BIT_TAMPER
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: Use +0 and -0 in a pure manufactured protected field pair; numeric equality is true but raw bits differ. This is a test of exact observation fidelity, not a new physical sign policy.

manufactured_counterexample_proposals.name: TRANSPORT_CHANGE_ALLOWED
manufactured_counterexample_proposals.construction: START_POST NC/NR differ from RESET_PRE after intervening source-timed transport, while both immediate START and RESET pairs preserve their NC/NR. No long-interval invariance assertion is allowed.

ledger_scope.note: Requested retained ledger policy; no checklist or historical payload was edited or newly promoted.

판정_ko: START/RESET의 첫 세 필드는 QNN·QNC·QNR 순서입니다. 초기입력 세 변수의 원래 REAL32 비트→START_PRE 대조와 각 START/RESET 직전·직후 QNC/QNR 보존을 추가하는 것이 최소 보강입니다. 그 사이 실제 수송·미세물리 변화까지 금지하거나 단위·population 정책을 변경하면 안 됩니다.
